sources.title: GitHub - cactus-compute/needle: 14MB foundation model for tiny devices ...
sources.snippet: Needle 2 is an open 45M-parameter model for tool calling, device use and structured extraction. The whole model is a single 14MB binary that runs a full session in about 28MB of RAM. It is built on our Simple Attention Network findings, compressed to CQ2-bit with Cactus Quants, and baked into its own engine. sources.title: Needle Engine — Ship 3D to the web from Unity, Blender, or code
sources.snippet: Needle Engine is a web 3D engine built on three.js. Build product configurators, web AR and games that run on every device — no app store, no install. Export from Unity and Blender, or write code.
